## Goal / acceptance criteria
A test that scans user-facing docs (`docs/user/`, `USER_GUIDE.md`, `FAMILY_QUICK_START.md`, `docs/HELPER_GUIDE.md`) for stale claims the existing guards miss: '15 seconds' first-start promises, 'Version 0.2'/'Coming in v0.x' phrasing for shipped features, and 'nothing is sent'. Read `tests/copilot/test_cp_wording_guard.py` first and cover only gaps. Fake cases prove it flags and passes. Report hits outside your lane as findings (don't edit them).

Fake data only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests must pass on Windows too: `tmp_path` and `pathlib`, no hard-coded `/tmp` or POSIX-only paths. A real product bug = strict `xfail` with the reason plus a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md; never edit `src/`. Check existing tests first (`tests/`, `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/`) and don't duplicate a guard.

## Allowed paths
- `tests/grok/test_gk_user_doc_claims.py`
- `tests/grok/__init__.py`
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/grok/test_gk_user_doc_claims.py && ../../.venv/bin/ruff check tests/grok`
